The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` passes (4 tests, 0 errors).

- **Fix:** In `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java` (around line 6518), the purchase-order subquery now has `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`. That is the same filter the per-quarter and latest purchase-order queries use.
- **Test:** I added `cancelledPurchaseOrdersAreNotCounted` to `src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest.java`. It covers your January example and expects Anna:2, Bob:1. I also added a status-taking overload of the test helper `purchaseOrder`; the existing one-argument calls still work.

Nothing is committed.
